name: Triple Shot
description: Shoot a bunch of arrows in a fan shape, dealing damage to multiple enemies.

name: Ice Arrow
description: Shoot an ice arrow toward the target that deals damage and has a chance to freeze the target.

name: Heal
description: Restores the life of the specified target.

name: Greater Defense
description: Temporarily increase the defense of the target.

name: Greater Damage
description: Temporarily increase the attack and magic power of the target.

name: Summon Goblin
description: Summon a goblin to fight by your side. Goblins disappear if they run out of life during battle.

name: Summon Stone Golem
description: Summon a Rock Monster to fight by your side. Stone Monsters disappear if they run out of life during battle.

name: Summon Assassin
description: Summon an Assassin to fight by your side. Assassins disappear if they run out of life during battle.

name: Summon Elite Yeti
description: Summon an Elite Yeti to fight by your side. Elite Yetis disappear if they run out of life during battle.

name: Summon Dark Knight
description: Summon a Dark Knight to fight by your side. Dark Knights disappear when they run out of life during battle.

name: Summon Bali
description: Summon a Bali to fight by your side. Balis disappear when they run out of life during battle.

name: Summon Soldier
description: Summon a Soldier to fight by your side. Soldiers disappear when they run out of life during battle.

name: Fire Slash
description: Swing a sword imbued with dark energy to deal damage to the target. Damaged targets have their defense decreased temporarily.

name: Power Slash
description: Swing the sword to send out a wind wave that deals multiple enemies.

name: Energy Ball
description: Send out a sphere of condensed energy to towards the target, dealing damage.

name: Fire Ball
description: Hurls a flaming stone at the target, dealing damage.

name: Lightning
description: A streak of lighting which deals damage and has a chance to knockback the target.

name: Teleport
description: Hide your body for a while and move it to another location.

name: Ice
description: Deal damage to the target with an ice attack which also has a chance to slow the target's movement speed.

name: Meteorite
description: Calls down a meteor from the sky at the target causing damage.

name: Poison
description: Deal poison damage to the target. It has a chance to deal additional poison damage over time.

name: Flame
description: Create a pillar of fire on the target that deals damage to the target and nearby enemies.

name: Twister
description: Send out a Twister towards the target area which deals damage to multiple enemies in its path.

name: Power Wave
description: Sends out an electrical wave that causes damage to the target.

name: Evil Spirit
description: Release the energy of darkness to deal damage to multiple enemies near you.

name: HellFire
description: Light the ground in flames with you as the center, dealing damage to multiple enemies.

name: Aqua Beam
description: Deal water damage to enemies in a straight line of the targeted direction.

name: Cometfall
description: Calls down light from the sky to the selected target and enemies near it to deal damage.

name: Soul Barrier
description: Create a mana shield on yourself or an ally which reduces damage taken in exchange for mana.

name: Inferno
description: Embrace yourself in a ring of fire that damages nearby enemies.

name: Teleport Ally
description: Forcibly bring an ally that is far away from you to your location.

name: Ice Storm
description: Drop a shard of ice at the targeted location, dealing damage to multiple targets in the area. Damaged targets have a chance to have their movement speed decreased.

name: Decay
description: Drop a poison boulder at the targeted location, dealing damage to multiple targets in the area. Damaged targets have a chance to take additional poison damage.

name: Nova
description: Draw forth the light energy from the surroundings and explode it at once, dealing damage to multiple enemies near you. Deal more damage the longer you charge up.

name: Force Wave
description: Send out a wave of wind to deal damage to the target.

name: Fire Burst
description: Create a fire chain to deal damage to the target and nearby enemies.

name: Earthshake
description: Dark Horse stomps the ground with its feet to cause an earth quake that deals damage to nearby enemies. Damaged enemies are knocked back.

name: Critical Damage Increase
description: Temporarily increases the critical damage of you and your party members.

name: Electric Spark
description: Consumes the life and mana of nearby party members to inflict damage to the target and enemies within a straight line.

name: Summon
description: Forcibly bring a party member that is far away from you to your location.

name: Fire Scream
description: Fires three flames at the ground, dealing damage to the target and bursting flames, dealing damage to nearby enemies as well.

name: Drain Life
description: Deal damage to the target and heal yourself for that amount.

name: Sleep
description: Temporarily put the target to sleep. Sleeping targets cannot perform any actions.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A streak of lightning attacks the target. The lightning can bounce up to 3 targets, dealing less damage per bounce.

name: Damage Reflection
description: Returns some of the damage taken to the target.

name: Berserker
description: Temporarily increases your magic and attack speed. In addition, defense and life are reduced.

name: Weakness
description: Temporarily decreases the attack power of nearby enemies.

name: Lightning Shock
description: Slam the ground hard to deal damage to nearby enemies.

name: Innovation
description: Temporarily decreases the defense of nearby enemies.

name: Falling Slash
description: Rapidly strike down the target with an axe or mace to deal damage.

name: Killing Blow
description: Swiftly punch the target 4 times and temporarily reduce target's damage.

name: Beast Uppercut
description: Swiftly punch the target 4 times and temporarily reduce target's defense.

name: Chain Drive
description: Kick the target 8 times and chance to reduce target's movement speed.

name: Dark Side
description: Create a clone of yourself to deal damage to nearby enemies twice.

name: Dragon Roar
description: With the target as the center, deal damage to nearby enemies 4 times with a fireball.

name: Dragon Slasher
description: Quickly charge the target. Chance to deal damage to SD and life on impact.

name: Ignore Defense
description: Temporarily grant yourself an effect which allows you to ignore targets defense.

name: Increase Health
description: Temporarily increase your and your party members an effect which increases stamina.

name: Increase Block
description: Temporarily increase your and your party members defense success rate.

name: Phoenix Shot
description: Send a cyclone towards the target, dealing damage to target and nearby enemies. The attack has a chance to knockback the target and decrease defense success rate.

name: Spirit Hook
description: Throws two-handed hooks at the target to inflict DMG to it and other enemies nearby.

name: Blood Howling
description: Every time you use a skill to yourself, the buff dealing bleed damage is activated.

name: Defense
description: Protect yourself with equipped shield to temporarily reduce damage.

name: Twisting Slash
description: Swing the equipped weapon to deal damage to nearby enemies.

name: Swell Life
description: Temporarily increases the life of you and party members.

name: Penetration
description: Shoot an arrow towards the target. Deals damage to target and enemies in its straight path towards the target.

name: Infinity Arrow
description: Upgrade the arrow so that arrow is no longer consumed.

name: Death Stab
description: Create a wave of wind that deals damage to the target and enemies in the straight path.

name: Rageful Blow
description: Slams your weapon down to the ground, causing an earthquake that deals damage to nearby enemies.

name: Strike of Destruction
description: Inflicts damage to the target and nearby enemies. Damaged targets have reduced movement speed.

name: Expansion of Wizardry
description: Temporarily increase min Magical DMG.

name: Multi Shot
description: Rapidly shoot arrows towards a direction to deal damage to multiple targets.

name: Recovery
description: Restores the SD of the target.

name: Flame Strike
description: Swing your weapon towards the targeted direction, dealing fire damage to multiple enemies.

name: Gigantic Storm
description: Call lightning from the sky to deal damage to multiple enemies near you.

name: Blood Storm
description: With the target as the center, deal damage to nearby enemies.

name: Chaotic Diseier
description: Summon a Dark Crow toward the targeted location to deal damage to multiple enemies.

name: Spin Step
description: Quickly stabs the target, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies.

name: Circle Shield
description: Temporarily reduce target's AG.

name: Harsh Strike
description: Wield a lance 2 times to deal damage to target.

name: Magic Pin
description: Rapidly pierce the target 3 times to deal damage.

name: Breche
description: Swing a lance once towards the targeted enemies.

name: Shining Peak
description: Thrust a lance quickly 3 times towards the targeted enemies.

name: Obsidian
description: Temporarily boosts Skill DMG of party members.

name: Wrath
description: Temporarily reduce your defense, but increase your damage significantly.

name: Burst
description: Temporarily increase a chance to ignore enemy's defense.

name: Fire Blow
description: Damage target and surrounding enemy 3 times. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Meteor Strike
description: Damage target and surrounding enemy 3 times by dropping powerful meteor. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Meteor Storm
description: With yourself as the center, deal damage to nearby enemies by dropping meteor.

name: Soul Seeker
description: Damage target and surrounding by sending evirl spirit. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Focus Shot
description: Damage target by firing arrow quickly 4 times. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Fire Beast
description: Damage target and surrounding enemy 3 times by summoning fire creature. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Aqua Beast
description: Damage target and surrounding enemy 3 times by summoning water creature. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Ice Blood
description: Does Ice damage to multiple enemy in a direction, has chance to cause one more additional damage. Attacked enemy has chance for movement speed reduction.

name: Fire Blood
description: Does Fire damage to multiple enemy in a direction, has chance to cause one more additional damage. Attacked enemy has chance for continuous fire damage.

name: Dark Blast
description: Damage target and surrounding by firing dark blast. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Chaos Blade
description: Inflicts Shadow damage to a large number of enemies in a wide range in front, and has a chance to deal 1 additional damage.

name: Havok Spear
description: Summons a magic spear from the ground, dealing damage to many nearby enemies.

name: Spiral Charge
description: Switch to two-handed sword Magic Gladiator. Attack and defense are increased. Chaos Blade and Fire Blood skill range increased to 6, and when using the skill, every third attack explodes sword in all directions, inflicting additional damage.

name: Crusher Charge
description: Switch to one-handed sword Magic Gladiator. Attack speed and defense are increased. Chaos Blade and Ice Blood skill range increased to 5, and when using the skill, the sword explodes in all directions for each third attack, inflicting additional damage.

name: Elemental Charge
description: Converts to a wizard-type Magic Gladiator. Increases horsepower and defense. Havok Spear skill range is increased to 7, and when using the skill, Nova explodes every third attack, inflicting additional damage.

name: Wind Soul
description: Damage target and surrounding by sending Evil Wind Spirit. Chance to cause one more additional damage.

name: Dark Phoenix Shot
description: Swing the equipped weapon to deal damage to nearby enemies.

name: Magic Arrow
description: Fire Magic Arrow on a target, and damage nearby enemies.

name: Plasma Ball
description: Blow Rune Energy in the targeted direction, and the Rune Energy moves and damages enemies.

name: Lightning Storm
description: Fire Rune Energy into the sky and drop it back to the ground, causing the Rune Energy to damage the enemies in the range.

name: Burst
description: Temporarily increase Skill MP consumption and increase DMG.

name: Haste
description: Temporarily increase Skill AG comsumption and increase attack speed of yourself and your party members.

name: Explosion
description: Call forth the devil of fire to deal damage to the target. The target takes additional fire damage over time.

name: Requiem
description: Summon the evil of darkness to deal damage to the target and nearby enemies. Attack deals additional damage over time.

name: Pollution
description: Call down an evil of wind at the target location, dealing damage to enemies within the area.

name: Death Scythe
description: Summons and controls the Death Resurrection to inflict damage on nearby enemies.

name: Darkness
description: Increases his low power and defense. Life is further reduced.

name: Blind
description: Inflicts DMG to and blinds the target to block its view, greatly reducing its attack success rate with a certain chance.

name: Sword Inertia
description: Rapidly moving from side to side and blows a swords to damage a number of enemies.

name: Bat Flock
description: Blows a swarm of bats around the target area, dealing damage to multiple enemies, and causing them to remain intact for some damage.

name: Detection
description: Temporarily detects the position of a creature in some range around it. The detection results are displayed on the minimap for 1 minute.

name: Pierce Attack
description: Quickly approaches and deals damage to multiple nearby enemies, dealing additional damage to targets that are dealing continuous damage from Bat Flock.

name: Demolish
description: Temporarily consumes 3% of your skill attack power and gives you and your party members the ability to ignore some of their enemy's defenses.

name: Rush
description: Quickly charge the target, and deal a powerful damage on impact.

name: Lunge
description: Rapidly pierce the target with a sharp weapon to deal damage.

name: Uppercut
description: Hit the target upwards to deal damage.

name: Cyclone
description: Hit the target in a spinning motion to deal damage.

name: Slash
description: Slash the target to deal damage.

name: Fire Breath
description: While you are mounted, quickly deal damage to the target.

name: Sword's Fury
description: Switch to anger knight. Increases the damage range and range of blow-based skills (including fire and sword blow).

name: Sword Blow
description: Causes a surge of sword, dealing damage to targets and nearby enemies.

name: Strong Belief
description: Switch to a conviction knight. Stat efficiency is changed and you can use exclusive skills.

name: Solid Protection
description: Increases the attack power/magic power of the party members and receives part of the damage after absorbing the party member's HP.

name: Death Fire
description: Fires bullets at high speed at the front of enemies dealing damage.

name: Death Ice
description: Fires ice bullets at high speed at enemies in front dealing damage.

name: Ice Break
description: Fires ice bullets, dealing damage to enemy targets.

name: Dark Plasma
description: Fires dark plasma at enemy targets. Dark plasma lasts for a certain period of time dealing damage to enemy targets.

name: Bursting Flare
description: Attacks enemies near and far away, as well as straight ranged targets.

name: Fixed Fire
description: The character's stats are changed, so the effects of magic power and attack speed increase, and the effect of defense power decreases.

name: Ice Blast
description: Fires an ice blast around you, dealing damage to near by enemies.

name: Magical Shot
description: Fires a projectile crafted from magic at the target, dealing damage.

name: Shining Bird
description: Launches a huge bird of light created by light magic in a specified direction, dealing damage to multiple enemies within range.

name: Dragon Violent
description: Creates a dragon of light around the target, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies.

name: Spear Storm
description: Fires a spear of light in a wide area, centered on you and inflicts damage to a number of nearby enemies.

name: Reflection Barrier
description: Creates a reflective barrier on yourself or an ally target, with a 50% chance to block damage and return a certain amount to the enemy when receiving shock damage.

name: Marvel Burst
description: Generates energy in the form of a bead that explodes on the target, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies.

name: Unleash Marvel
description: Creates a large marble-shaped energy ar a designated location, and sends out small amounts of energy, dealing damage to multiple enemies within range.

name: Ultimate Force
description: Creates a magic circle at the designated location and sends small energy to the magic circle, dealing damage to multiple enemies within range.

name: Cure
description: Removes status effect from the target with a certain chance.

name: Party Healing
description: With the target as the center, recover up to 3 party members life. The amount of recovery decreases each time the target is changed.

name: Poison Arrow
description: Inflicts a strong DMG to the target and deals poison DMG over time with a certain chance.

name: Bless
description: Increase all stats of target for a set time period.

name: Summon Satyros
description: Summon a Satyros to fight by your side. Satyros disappear if they run out of life during battle.

name: Shadow Step
description: Quickly moves in a designated direction.

name: Evasion
description: Temporarily increase your base defense success rate, and remove immobilization effect.

name: Earth Prison
description: Deal damage to the target and its nearby enemies. It has a chance to make the targets immobilized.

name: Illusion
description: Make a phantom copy of yourself to fight together. This phantom absorbs some of damage main body receives.

name: Illusion Blade
description: Duplicate the right-handed sword to summon a phantom sword in the left hand. Illusion Knight's attack power is greatly increased.

name: Charge Slash
description: The Illusion Knight quickly charges to the enemy and attacks by emitting powerful sword energy in a fan-shaped area.

name: Wind Glaive
description: Attacks the enemy by emitting a tornado-type sword in front.

name: Illusion Avatar
description: Summons your own Illusion. Illusion Knight charges and attacks nearby enemies.

name: Blade Storm
description: Sharp phantom blades create a storm around the character, attacking multiple enemies in a wide area.

name: Angel Homunculus
description: Creates two Angel Homunculus through alchemy and orders them to attack, dealing damage to multiple targets.

name: Ignition Bomber
description: Creates stone bombs through alchemy, dealing damage to multiple targets within range.

name: Confusion Stone
description: A Confusion Stone is created through alchemy. For a certain period, the Confusion Stone summons one monster at a time from the field.

name: Countless Weapon
description: Creates weapons with alchemy and hurls them through the air, dealing damage to multiple targets within range.

name: Archangel's will
description: It is a skill from Upgraded Archangel weapon.

name: Basic Healing
description: Restores Life of specified target.

name: Basic Recovery
description: Recovers SD of specified target.

name: Basic Defense Increase
description: Temporarily increases the defense of specified target.

name: Basic Attack Increase
description: Temporarily increases attack and magic power of specified target.

name: Basic Bless
description: Increases all stats of specified target for a certain period of time.

name: Poison Storm
description: Explosion damage is applied to poisoned targets, and an option effect enhanced through the Blasting debuff.

name: Frozen Slayer
description: Explosion damage is applied to frozen targets, and an option effect enhanced through the Blasting debuff.

name: Bloodying Hit
description: Explosion damage is applied to bleeding targets, and the option effect enhanced through the Blasting debuff.

name: Plasma Storm
description: Shoot three consecutive lightning strikes to deal damage to the target and nearby enemies. Damaged targets have their armor's durability decreased.

name: Common Action
description: Follows the master.

name: Random Attack
description: Attack enemies near the master.

name: Joint Attack
description: Attacks the target its master is attacking.

name: Targeted Attack
description: Only attacks the target that the master selects.

name: Lance
description: Throw a dagger at the target to deal damage.

name: Crescent Moon Slash
description: Rapidly strike the target downward with a weapon to deal damage.

name: Clash
description: Collide with your target and push nearby enemies away.

name: Charge
description: Throw a powerful blow at the target to deal damage.

name: Fire Blast
description: Create a pillar of light to deal damage to the target.

name: Spiral Slash
description: Rapidly swing your sword to deal damage to the target.

name: Mana Rays
description: Condense your magic power to a point and shootit to the target, dealing damage.

name: Starfall
description: Shoot an arrow high up in the air to deal damage to the target.
